title: /goal Mission 1 of 5: native unattended S1 G0-G4 causal autonomy proof and original-branch repair
question: /goal: Audit exact current single S1 runtime and original GitHub owners. Find and falsify at most THREE highest-leverage CURRENT unresolved native unattended G0 discovery -> G1 source-bound diagnosis -> G2 original branch authorized repair -> G3 exact-head hosted CI+reviews+native expected-head merge -> G4 main+natural consumer readback defects. Distinguish documented scheduled S1 original #1946 merge from owner-interactive #1962 merge and from prompt-only capabilities. Identify the real original scheduled receiver and any missing authenticated ACK/job/results/consumer link; no invented tool powers. Source-rooted root-cause dependency graph and minimal executable deterministic repair specifications. Critically verify if Sol prior C2 finalize PASS without matching output is a real consumer bug or merely intentional artifact-write status; reject speculative changes. Existing #1962 source-loss failclosed patch is already MERGED and must not be proposed again. Cross-repo P0 owner discovery, stale HOLD, Strategist routing and four-touch SLA must be examined only as upstream S1 autonomy blockers. Compare native S1 performance against cheaper existing no-new-code route. Exact code/functions/line locator and evidence class for every claim. Return 0-3 real nonoverlapping patches with positive and guard-removal negatives, rollback and qualified original owner. Do not create new queue, scheduler, workflow, bot, agent, paid API scanner, PR spam, governance bypass or self-authorizing model.
hypothesis: The remaining high-value S1 autonomy bottleneck is not generic model reasoning but an authenticated native request->receiver->repair->merge->consumer evidence/authority edge, potentially in output admission or original owner routing. A genuine null result is acceptable.
baseline: Original scheduled S1 #1946 native merge proves bounded closure, but unattended full source-repair G0-G4 remains UNPROVEN; interactive #1962 fixed one input-loss issue and is NOT S1 autonomous. Existing S1 runbook, original issue #1156, Strategist #1157, Sol previous triage #1476 and current source on main. Compare no-new-code natural scheduled observation with new patch.
falsifier: Show a real current scheduled S1 run with immutable authenticated G0-G4 original PR branch repair+CI+merge+main+natural consumer, or show that proposed gap is already guarded by caller and no legitimate failure occurs. If missing independent high-impact review/permissions/source or provider consent is the only blocker, classify EXTERNAL and do not patch around it. Never confuse chat-owned merge or JSON PASS with autonomous proof.
kill_condition: No duplicate #1962 patch, no private reads, no raw wallets, no new S1/queue/cron/agent, no automatic review or permission escalation, no code/PR/merge by Sol, no live trading, no unverifiable self-awarded autonomous proof, no new paid follow-up without fresh material evidence.
forbidden: model merge or independent reviewer impersonation
